Hi Marissa & Jonas,

Thanks again for joining the call today — great to meet you both. Quick recap from CloudWave / Acme side: Todd is evaluating an inference platform to standardize LLM endpoints across their product org and prefers partner-led engagements where CloudWave manages initial infra sizing and procurement.

Next steps we agreed on during the call:
- Joint demo / technical deep dive with Redwood infra/serving team + CloudWave solutions architects + Acme platform engineers
- Review integration points for marketplace provisioning (CloudWave-managed) and SSO/KMS requirements
- Share a short one-pager on the partner offering (attached)

Proposed attendees:
- From Redwood: Marissa Cole (sales), Jonas Weber (solutions/technical lead)
- From CloudWave: Sarah Brown (partner lead), Miguel Santos (solutions architect)
- From Acme: Todd Sparks (platform), Claire Nguyen (security)

Can everyone share availability for a 60-minute slot next week? I have open windows on:
- Tue 2025-06-17 10:00-12:00 PT
- Wed 2025-06-18 14:00-16:00 PT

If you prefer, you can pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/cloudwave/30min (CloudWave will send the final invite with join info).

Let me know if we should prep anything specific for the deep dive (load patterns, model types, expected RPS).

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Brown
Partner Lead, CloudWave Solutions

- Wed 2025-06-18 14:30-15:30 PT
